title: The Pale Protocol
author: Gideon Galloway
blurb: Edmund Joubert, the last human technician on an automated relay station, has spent twelve years hauling cargo through contested orbits. Then gravity flickers across the entire system for exactly nine seconds — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
